title: A better way to explore
changes: Redesigned map with dedicated Charging and Rivian Places views, category filters, and distinct markers for Spaces, Demo Centers, Service Centers, Outposts, RAN, and Waypoints.
Expanded charging details include pricing, connector types, charging speeds, and individual port information where available.
Color-coded charging ratings appear in search results, map details, saved places, and location pages.
Automatic data refreshes keep location information current, with dated maintenance and charger issue reports in location details.

title: Search, directions, and mobile improvements
changes: Added King of Prussia Space (opening Feb 21, 2026)
Updated Seattle University Village Space to open status
Added 8 new Service Centers: Long Island City NY, Iselin NJ, Martinez CA, Olathe KS, Hazelwood MO, Vaughan ON, Niagara Falls NY, Stallings NC
Removed 4 duplicate Service Center entries
Updated color palette to official Rivian brand colors (Launch Green, Rivian Blue)
Added address and zip code search via Mapbox geocoding
Added distance badges on location cards when user location is enabled
Added "Get Directions" button with platform-aware deep links (Apple Maps on iOS, Google Maps elsewhere)
Redesigned filter buttons as horizontal scrolling chips
Improved mobile experience with bottom sheet and swipe gestures
Added resource preloading for faster initial load
Added image optimization to build pipeline (WebP conversion)

title: Service Centers and improved location information
changes: Added 34 Service Center locations from official Rivian data
Added direct links to Rivian.com for all locations
Implemented automatic dark/light mode based on system preference
Fixed mobile PWA layout and safe area spacing
Updated location hours from Rivian.com
Added La Jolla Space and San Jose Service Center
Updated README and About page with changelog
Fixed GitHub Actions deprecation errors
Added Service Centers count to stats

title: Rivian Spotter launches
changes: Initial launch with Spaces, Demo Centers, and Outposts
Interactive map with marker clustering
Search and filter by location type
Advanced filters (state, services, date range, distance)
Open Now / Coming Soon quick filters
Favorites and recent locations
Export to CSV/JSON
PWA support with offline caching
Statistics page
Mobile-responsive design
